ACKNOWLEDGMENTS
If ever there were a situation where one should start their 
acknowledgments by thanking Hashem, it is surely when writing a commentary on a siddur!
Yet, to be honest, I struggle with that. Whenever I see 
authors start by offering thanks to Hashem, I’ve always thought to myself, “Duh! Isn’t that obvious? Does it really need to be said?” But I now understand that it
need to be said! (See FAQs for why.) But more importantly, I learned
I am thanking Him for. At the end of

,” and I struggled to understand what it meant. I discovered that we are thanking Hashem “for instilling in us the concept and (crucial) character trait of gratitude!” It’s so easy (at least for some of us) to confidently roll along feeling that we’re in control — just that we need Hashem to not “get in our way.” What a tragic mistake. As I look back at all the details Hashem had to put into place in order to get me to the point of putting out this siddur, it is humbling indeed! So I do want to offer

, but not simply for giving me the wherewithal to produce this work. More importantly, I want to thank Him for giving me the ability to recognize His Hand in all areas of my life, being able to recognize my strengths and know my limitations, and most importantly, for having sense enough to thank Him for all that!
